From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: real, real., reál, reâl, and réal

English

[edit]

Proper noun

[edit]

Real

  1. (soccer) Real Madrid, a football club from Madrid.
  2. A surname.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • Real County (from a surname)

Statistics

[edit]
  • According to the 2010 United States Census, Real is the 5045th most common surname in the United States, belonging to 6,959 individuals. Real is most common among Hispanic (60.11%) and White (30.09%) individuals.

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Arel, Earl, Elar, Lare, Lear, Rael, Raël, earl, lare, lear, rale

Catalan

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • Ral
  • Ral i Ordelló

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic, Valencia) [reˈal]

Proper noun

[edit]

Real m

  1. town of the Capcir district, in the Northern Catalonia, now part of the Pyrénées-Orientales department in France

Proper noun

[edit]

Real m or f by sense

  1. a Catalan surname

German

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʁeˈaːl/
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -aːl

Noun

[edit]

Real m (strong, genitive Reals, plural Real or Reales)

  1. real (former Spanish currency unit)

Noun

[edit]

Real m (strong, genitive Reals, plural Real or Reais or Réis or Reis)

  1. real (Brazilian and former Portuguese currency unit)

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • Rial (dated)

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁeˈaw/ [heˈaʊ̯]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʁeˈaw/ [heˈaʊ̯]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /ʁeˈaw/ [χeˈaʊ̯]
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈʁjal/ [ˈʁjaɫ]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈʁjal/ [ˈʁjaɫ]
    • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈʁja.li/

  • Homophones: real, rial (Portugal), Rial (Portugal)
  • Hyphenation: Re‧al

Proper noun

[edit]

Real ?

  1. a parish of Castelo de Paiva, district of Aveiro, Portugal
  2. a parish of Braga, district of Braga, Portugal
  3. a parish of Amarante, district of Porto, Portugal
  4. a parish of Penalva do Castelo, district of Viseu, Portugal
